properties.evidence: COVERED as of 2026-08-08 (chg:duplicate-merge-needs-a-human-20260808): HEAL proposes a merge only for a DUPLICATES edge explicitly carrying basis=asserted, so a heuristic can no longer drive an irreversible deletion, and the check-health skill no longer describes node deletion as the safe mechanical half to apply unread. NOT COVERED, and deliberately not claimed: the requirement's second clause -- that on a shared graph the acting seat must acknowledge other sessions are attached -- is unbuilt, because nothing in any payload yet reports concurrency at all. That is req:a-session-can-tell-it-is-not-alone, which this clause is blocked on; building the acknowledgement first would mean asking a seat to confirm a fact reflow2 cannot currently tell it.
